features.quote: Next to the structures were found large rock-cut basins

date.basis: not dated; entry says the link of the rock-cut installations to the structures is unclear

notes: s2f2: the basins lie next to the ~20 structures inside the 200x200 m courtyard, which the entry places on the northern slope of the site's hill, hence N from the site; no size given, so pool_def unclear. Fig. 306 (p. 430) is a 0-5 m plan of three structures only, with small unlabelled rock features; the unit point cannot be placed on it, so nothing was measured or coded from it. Entry grid 1870/1672 is ~360 m from the unit point.
